description: watchdog.remove with the digest of the removal statement: a removal always loosens a safeguard (a rule that is gone will never fire), so it always confirms, any origin — the system seed's provenance does not make its removal free. The digest here is the SHA-256 of the statement the daemon rendered from the row, the same one a confirm-required refusal hands the client, so the removal completes in one round trip. The row is disabled, never deleted (LC11): the audit and the id outlive the removal, so the seed's ledger and a fire's rule reference keep resolving.
